messages:
Nora: Quick round on Compliance > Storage settings mock. Screenshot attached.
Chen: saw it. two low-hanging things: retention label and the KMS badge wording.
Diego: KMS badge currently says 'Customer key' which some customers read as 'we keep it'. I'd prefer 'Customer-managed key (BYOK)'.
Priya: +1. also add a short helper: 'You control the key; Redwood does not have key material.' Put it in the hover and SR-only text.
ux-bot: a11y report: lock icon contrast 2.3:1 on light theme (fail). Recommend darker icon (#122032) or show text label next to icon.
Nora: retention control is pushed under the region dropdown on narrow screens. Proposal: collapse region into pill and surface 'Auto-delete after' inline with current value.
Chen: wording suggestion: change label from 'Retention (days)' to 'Auto-delete after' and helper: 'Data will be permanently deleted after the selected period.'
Diego: modal confirm copy: change 'Are you sure?' to 'Permanently delete data after [X days]? This action cannot be undone.' Add a link to the retention policy.
Priya: audit log UX: event names in list are raw (e.g., `data.purge_triggered`). Show friendly label in table and raw event type in expandable JSON. Example map:
`{
  "data.purge_triggered": "Retention purge executed",
  "kms.rotate": "Key rotated"
}`
Nora: nice. also show local time + relative: 'Mar 02 2025, 09:34 PST — 5m ago'. Add header control to switch to UTC.
ux-bot: keyboard/focus checklist: ensure tab order is toggle -> region -> retention -> KMS, make retention value updates announce via aria-live polite, and make rows in audit table keyboard-focusable with `aria-expanded` states.
Chen: i'll reorder DOM and add aria-live region. Diego, can you review copy PR tomorrow?
Diego: will do. i'll also update the icon color and provide alternate text for the lock badge.
Nora: created TRACK-998 (retention wording + modal) and TRACK-999 (kms badge + a11y). tagging @Chen @Diego @Priya. :thumbsup:
